In 21 years, 5 leap years and 16 ordinary years.

questions.question: A person was born on 19 April 2008. What day of the week will be on his 22nd birthday?
questions.solution:
**Given: **A person was born on 19 April 2008.

His 22nd birthday will be on:

19 April (2008 + 22) = 19 April 2030

Since the starting date is 19 April 2008, the leap day (February 29) of 2008 has already passed and is not counted. We count the leap years from 2008 to 2030:

Total number of leap years = 5 (2012, 2016, 2020, 2024, 2028)

Total Ordinary years = 22 - 5 = 17
